name: kernel-lang
description: Syntax highlighting + real LSP diagnostics for Kernel (.kn), a from-scratch systems language with real move/borrow checking, generics, closures, and three verified backends (interpreter, freestanding C, native LLVM).

kernel.serverPath.description: Path to the `kernel` compiler binary (must support the `lsp` subcommand). Defaults to `kernel` on PATH -- build the compiler (`cargo build --release` in the kernel-lang repo) and either add target/release to PATH or set this to the full binary path.
